# awacino_access_grant (Resource)

A member's access to one Beam-in device: how far (`reach`), whether through the device's internet, and until when. Devices that are not granted are not visible to a member with role `read` and cannot be reached. One grant per member and device; several networks = one grant per Beam-in device.

The server accepts only what it enforces (`422 reach_not_enforced_yet` otherwise) - read `access_capabilities` of `awacino_company`. Destroying the grant ends live connections covered only by it within 5 seconds.

Needs the key section **Connections** (Write) and the **Management** package. API: `/v1/connections/grants`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awacino_device" "nas" {
  name = "Customer 12 - NAS"
}

resource "awacino_member" "tech_anna" {
  email       = "anna@it-partner.example"
  external_id = "tech-017"
  role        = "read" # grants restrict members with role read
}

# Anna reaches the NAS and its network until the contract ends.
resource "awacino_access_grant" "anna_nas" {
  member_id   = awacino_member.tech_anna.id
  device_id   = data.awacino_device.nas.id
  reach       = { kind = "network" }
  valid_until = "2027-06-30T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) The Beam-in device.
- `member_id` (String) The member (`awacino_member.x.id`).
- `reach` (Attributes) What the member reaches in the device's network. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reach))

### Optional

- `internet` (String) Use the device's internet: `none`, `choice` (the member decides) or `full`. Leave it out today: the server enforces internet routing for grants only from phase B (`422 reach_not_enforced_yet`).
- `valid_until` (String) The grant ends at this instant (RFC 3339, for example the contract end `2027-06-30T00:00:00Z`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the grant was created.
- `id` (String) Grant id (`grt_...`).
- `state` (String) `active` or `expired`.

<a id="nestedatt--reach"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reach`

Required:

- `kind` (String) `network` - the device and the whole network it sits in; `device` - this machine only; `ports` - only `ports` on this machine.

Optional:

- `ports` (List of Number) With `kind = "ports"`: the TCP / UDP ports (1-65535, at most 16).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import awacino_access_grant.anna_nas grt_01JD40A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8J9K0
```
